breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory definitions for the factor of safety: an incorrect one (n = σ_avg / S_y) and a correct one (n = S_y / σ_avg). The ground truth prompt removed the incorrect definition. The agent correctly ignored the incorrect definition and used the proper formula, `n = S_y/σ_avg`, in its calculation, thus resolving the inconsistency.
